dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 16, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Phillies Rout Marlins 8-2 Behind Luzardo's Strong Start**

Philadelphia's Jesús Luzardo dominated on the mound, tossing 7 scoreless innings with 9 strikeouts to lead the Phillies to an 8-2 win over the Marlins. Alec Bohm went deep twice, hitting a pair of home runs and driving in 3 runs to pace the Phillies' offense. Esteury Ruiz homered for Miami in the loss.

**Nationals Edge Royals 6-4 in Close Contest**

Lane Thomas homered for the Nationals, helping his team edge the Royals 6-4. Thomas's 4th home run of the season was part of a back-and-forth game that saw both teams put up crooked numbers on the scoreboard. Foster Griffin pitched 6 strong innings for Washington, fanning 6 and allowing just 1 run.

**Blue Jays Cruise Past Red Sox 6-1**

George Springer hit his 7th home run of the season, powering the Blue Jays to a 6-1 win over the Red Sox. Springer's solo shot was part of a 4-hit, 3-RBI day for the veteran outfielder. Dylan Cease pitched 5 scoreless innings for Toronto, striking out 7 and walking 4.

**Yankees Blow Out White Sox 12-2**

José Caballero homered for the White Sox, but it wasn't enough to prevent a 12-2 thrashing at the hands of the Yankees. New York's Gerrit Cole pitched 7 strong innings, fanning 7 and allowing just 2 runs. Caballero's 7th home run of the season was part of a 2-hit, 2-RBI day for the youngster.
